newsitem.title: UK: Mobil to sell UK gas to Netherlands - consultant.
newsitem.headline: Mobil to sell UK gas to Netherlands - consultant.

text.p: Mobil may shortly sign a contract to sell gas from the UK sector of the North Sea into the Netherlands through the Interconnector pipeline, a prominent consultant told an industry conference on told on Wednesday.

Independent gas consultant Floor Touber said that Mobil, which is not a shareholder in the Interconnector, was about to conclude a contract to sell gas in the South of the Netherlands to both large industrial consumers and a local distribution company.

"This is a big step", said Touber, "as until now only shareholders have sold gas through the Interconnector. Now Mobil, which has gas but no capacity, is doing it, so capacity trading is now on the way".
Mobil declined to comment. A spokesman told Reuters that "we cannot confirm or deny the story, but we are aware of the rumours".
The Interconnector, a 240km-long, 450 million stg high pressure link from Bacton in Norfolk to Zeebrugge in Belgium, is under construction and scheduled to open in late 1998.

It will have a capacity of 20 billion cubic metres (bcm) a year, divided between nine shareholders. So far DuPont's Conoco has contracted to sell one bcm a year to Wintershall/Gazprom joint venture Wingas for ten years from 1998.
British Gas has also concluded a deal to sell Wingas 20 bcm over 10 years starting in 1998.
